title: Noise sensitivity by Fourier level
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0\le\delta\le1$, and let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs. Its noise sensitivity at rate $\delta$ equals one half times the sum, over levels $k=0,\ldots,n$, of $\bigl(1-(1-2\delta)^k\bigr)$ times the total squared Fourier weight of the real-valued version of $f$ at level $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs
